FAQ

Questions, answered

How is this different from Claude Tag?

Claude Tag is Claude, in Slack, on Anthropic's infrastructure. AgentConnect is an open-source, self-hostable stack: run any ACP-compatible agent across Slack, Discord, Telegram, and GitHub.

How is this different from OpenClaw?

OpenClaw is a personal assistant — one instance, one machine, one operator. AgentConnect is built for teams: run agents across multiple machines to keep use cases isolated from each other, control which members see which agents, tools, and skills, and let the whole team work with the same agents in shared channels.

Which agents can I use?

Any ACP-compatible agent. Run Claude Code, Codex, and other ACP runtimes side by side, and choose the runtime and model for each agent. When a new ACP runtime ships, it plugs straight in — no waiting on us.

Do I need my own model accounts or API keys?

Yes — agents run with your own provider subscriptions or API keys. Model traffic flows directly between your machines and your provider: AgentConnect never proxies it and never marks up usage.

Why not build my own bot?

A bot connects messages to an agent. AgentConnect adds the team layer around it: identities, routing and handoffs, memory, permissions, schedules, tools, and shared visibility across channels — the glue every team ends up rebuilding on its own.

Where do my code and conversations go?

They stay on your own machines. An agent isn't just an API call — it's a process that checks out your repos, runs commands, and holds your credentials. That process runs on daemons you operate, right next to your code; only the model call goes out, straight to your provider. The Control Plane stores configuration and metadata — never message bodies, transcripts, or code — and optional relays only forward inbound messages without storing them.

What is the Cloud waitlist for?

Early access to the hosted AgentConnect Cloud console. The open-source stack is available to self-host today.

FAQ

问题，已解答

这和克劳德·塔格有什么不同？

Claude Tag 是 Slack 中 Anthropic 基础设施上的 Claude。 AgentConnect 是一个开源、可自托管的堆栈：跨 Slack、Discord、Telegram 和 GitHub 运行任何与 ACP 兼容的代理。

这与 OpenClaw 有什么不同？

OpenClaw 是一个个人助理——一个实例、一台机器、一个操作员。 AgentConnect 专为团队构建：跨多台机器运行代理以保持用例相互隔离，控制哪些成员查看哪些代理、工具和技能，并让整个团队在共享通道中使用相同的代理。

我可以使用哪些代理？

任何 ACP 兼容代理。 并行运行 Claude Code、Codex 和其他 ACP 运行时，并为每个代理选择运行时和模型。 当新的 ACP 运行时发布时，它会直接插入 - 无需等待我们。

我需要自己的模型帐户或 API 密钥吗？

是的 - 代理使用您自己的提供商订阅或 API 密钥运行。 对直接在您的计算机和提供商之间流动的流量进行建模：AgentConnect 从不代理它，也从不标记使用情况。

为什么不构建我自己的机器人？

机器人将消息连接到代理。 AgentConnect 在其周围添加了团队层：身份、路由和切换、内存、权限、时间表、工具以及跨渠道的共享可见性 - 每个团队最终都会自行重建的粘合剂。

我的代码和对话去哪里了？

它们保留在您自己的机器上。 代理不仅仅是一个 API 调用，它是一个检查您的存储库、运行命令并保存您的凭据的过程。 该进程在您操作的守护进程上运行，就在您的代码旁边；只有模型呼叫会直接发送给您的提供商。 控制平面存储配置和元数据——从不存储消息正文、文字记录或代码——并且可选中继仅转发入站消息而不存储它们。
